decision: CI is active; repository Actions policy is not the blocker. The canonical npm test / node --test suite itself fails on the current main commit. Do not claim full-suite validation until the failing assertions are identified and corrected.
evidenceBoundary: The connector exposed run/job/check metadata but not job log bodies or annotation payloads in this relay runtime, so the exact failing test names/messages are not inferred.
nextGate: Retrieve the two check annotations or job logs, fix only the observed failing tests/implementation, push, and require a green Test workflow before treating the harness as fully validated.
